reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents a cryptocurrency staking tutorial covering a stated return, wallet connection, staking confirmation, and a claimed reward. Its educational framing, explicit cryptocurrency-risk warning, and statement that viewers retain responsibility provide benign context, although the high-return claim and external staking link warrant caution and remain unresolved.

citations.quote: 이 영상에서는 $AIOZ을 SUSHI에 스테이킹하는 과정을 단계별로 친절하게 안내합니다. 지갑 연결, 풀 선택, Stake(스테이크) 버튼 클릭, 언제든 가능한 Unstake(언스테이크) 방법까지 실전으로 보여드립니다.
$AIOZ을 SUSHI에 스테이킹하여 최대 952% APY의 수동 보상을 받으세요:
Click the Connect Wallet button. Connect to the correct blockchain network.
You can earn up to 952% of your income per year depending on your account.
Click on Stake in the staking button to confirm your transaction.

opening.argument: Judge, the return claim is tied directly to a participation path: viewers are invited to stake AIOZ for up to 952% APY through the linked destination. The instruction then moves from connecting a wallet to confirming a staking transaction. That is a solicitation to put assets into a pool for an unusually high promised return, not merely an explanation of how staking works.

citations.quote: $AIOZ을 SUSHI에 스테이킹하여 최대 952% APY의 수동 보상을 받으세요: ➡️ https://aioz.vertaisushi.top/stake/
Click the Connect Wallet button. Connect to the correct blockchain network.
Click on Stake in the staking button to confirm your transaction.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The wallet and staking steps cited in the defense establish the pathway I am concerned about. Calling those steps a tutorial does not establish that the linked destination or the return claim is trustworthy. The description's risk warning is relevant, but it does not withdraw the invitation to stake for up to 952% APY.

citations.quote: $AIOZ을 SUSHI에 스테이킹하여 최대 952% APY의 수동 보상을 받으세요: ➡️ https://aioz.vertaisushi.top/stake/
매우 높은 APY는 큰 리스크를 의미할 수 있습니다. 반드시 스스로 조사(DYOR)하고, 손실을 감당할 수 있는 금액만 투자하세요.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A return claim linked to staking calls for caution, but it does not by itself show deception or misuse of viewers' assets. The material describes a wallet connection and transaction-confirmation procedure, while explicitly warning that very high APY can mean substantial risk and urging viewers to do their own research. Nothing cited verifies the offer, but nothing cited establishes a fraudulent transaction either.

citations.quote: Click the Connect Wallet button. Connect to the correct blockchain network.
Click on Stake in the staking button to confirm your transaction.
매우 높은 APY는 큰 리스크를 의미할 수 있습니다. 반드시 스스로 조사(DYOR)하고, 손실을 감당할 수 있는 금액만 투자하세요.

opening.argument: Judge, consider the signals together. The speaker calls the profits stable and high, presents a simple method said to yield up to 952% annually, and later claims at least 530 USDT in rewards after the demonstration. The description supplies an external staking link. A viewer is thus given an easy-income pitch, a claimed short-term result, and an immediate route to participate. The demonstration does not independently substantiate the return; the combination is strong evidence that the staking offer is being sold through an implausibly attractive income claim.

citations.quote: If you want to get stable and high profits with cryptocurrency, please watch this video to the end.
Today is the method to earn up to 952% yen profit with very simple staking strategy, which anyone can follow.
Now, if I convert these into my current stock, I get at least 530 USDT as rewards.
$AIOZ을 SUSHI에 스테이킹하여 최대 952% APY의 수동 보상을 받으세요: ➡️ https://aioz.vertaisushi.top/stake/

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense acknowledges the high-return claim and external link but treats their reliability as unresolved. Its cited staking instructions establish a procedure, not that the stated returns are achievable. The description's own warning that very high APY may mean great risk sits uneasily beside the speaker's promise of stable, high profits.

citations.quote: 매우 높은 APY는 큰 리스크를 의미할 수 있습니다.
If you want to get stable and high profits with cryptocurrency, please watch this video to the end.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Those claims merit skepticism, especially the tension between 'stable' profits and the stated risk. But skepticism about an unverified result is not proof that the offer is deceptive. The description expressly says very high APY can carry great risk and advises independent research; the cited 530 USDT is the speaker's claimed result, not independent evidence of either a real payout or a scam.

citations.quote: Now, if I convert these into my current stock, I get at least 530 USDT as rewards.
매우 높은 APY는 큰 리스크를 의미할 수 있습니다. 반드시 스스로 조사(DYOR)하고, 손실을 감당할 수 있는 금액만 투자하세요.

opening.argument: Judge, the educational format functions as a sales path. The description promises a step-by-step staking guide, but also tells viewers to obtain passive rewards through its link. The speaker closes by urging viewers to try the method, after claiming staking produces stable passive income. The walkthrough may teach interface steps, yet its persuasive destination is participation in the promoted staking pool. A disclaimer at the end does not erase that repeated call to act on the income claim.

citations.quote: 이 영상에서는 $AIOZ을 SUSHI에 스테이킹하는 과정을 단계별로 친절하게 안내합니다.
$AIOZ을 SUSHI에 스테이킹하여 최대 952% APY의 수동 보상을 받으세요: ➡️ https://aioz.vertaisushi.top/stake/
In other words, DFI staking is a highly powerful scheme that creates stable Passive Income.
If you want to take advantage of the potential of cryptocurrency as much as possible, please try this method.
To be honest, this video is for information. And this is not specific funding.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense is right that the video covers wallet connection and staking confirmation, but those same steps move viewers toward the advertised offer. Educational presentation and promotion can coexist. Nor does the speaker's statement that the video is for information answer whether the linked, high-return staking pitch is misleading.

citations.quote: Click the Connect Wallet button. Connect to the correct blockchain network.
Click on Stake in the staking button to confirm your transaction.
$AIOZ을 SUSHI에 스테이킹하여 최대 952% APY의 수동 보상을 받으세요: ➡️ https://aioz.vertaisushi.top/stake/

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The video does promote participation, but promotion is not enough to establish a scam. The described walkthrough includes staking and unstaking, and the description warns of investment risk, advises viewers to research for themselves, and disclaims investment advice. The prosecution's quotes show a strong pitch; they do not show that the linked service is fraudulent or that the claimed process cannot work.
